skills.title: Market-implied reverse DCF
skills.formula: Search growth, operating margin or WACC for model price equal to observed price; report roots and invalid intervals.
skills.required_inputs: Point-in-time evidence, exact code/model revisions, valuation inputs, market price, dated OHLCV observations, adjustment basis and hypothesis.
skills.assumptions: Fixed remaining inputs, explicit bounds, base FCFF only.
skills.validation: Recover a known input from its computed price; report out-of-range and multiple solutions instead of extrapolating.
skills.failure_modes: Price forecasts cannot silently become intrinsic-value assumptions. Agent consensus is not independent evidence. Optional model weights and APIs are not installed or invoked by default.
steps: Separate instrument discovery, evidence acquisition, deterministic valuation, forecast experiments and narrative synthesis.
Identify market-implied assumptions with bounded reverse valuation; test earnings/cash conversion before interpreting value.
Evaluate forecasts using rolling training cutoffs and a random-walk benchmark; audit pretrained training overlap separately.
Require bull and bear cases to specify evidence, numerical driver changes and falsification dates; unresolved disagreement remains visible.

skills.title: Enterprise DCF
skills.formula: FCFF = EBIT - operating cash tax + depreciation - capex - change in operating NWC; EV = discounted FCFF + discounted terminal value.
skills.required_inputs: Dated statements, forecast drivers, valuation purpose, currency, cost of capital, claims and peer definitions.
skills.assumptions: Cash flows and WACC share currency, inflation and operating perimeter.
skills.validation: Reconcile statements; compare a hand-calculated perpetuity and test discount-rate monotonicity.
skills.failure_modes: Do not apply the operating-company FCFF model to deposit-funded banks, insurers, negative terminal earnings or distressed optional equity without a separate model.
steps: Select enterprise or equity cash flows before choosing a discount rate.
Normalize revenue, operating costs, working capital and reinvestment; reconcile the opening balance sheet.
Link growth to reinvestment and return on capital; challenge terminal margins and duration of advantage.
Calculate at least one economically appropriate cross-check, then explain disagreement instead of averaging incompatible values.

skills.title: Terminal economics
skills.formula: Terminal FCFF = next-year NOPAT × (1 - g / ROIC).
skills.required_inputs: Dated statements, forecast drivers, valuation purpose, currency, cost of capital, claims and peer definitions.
skills.assumptions: WACC > g; ROIC > g; terminal EBIT positive.
skills.validation: Growth at zero produces no growth reinvestment; higher growth is not automatically value accretive.
skills.failure_modes: Do not apply the operating-company FCFF model to deposit-funded banks, insurers, negative terminal earnings or distressed optional equity without a separate model.
steps: Select enterprise or equity cash flows before choosing a discount rate.

Link growth to reinvestment and return on capital; challenge terminal margins and duration of advantage.
Calculate at least one economically appropriate cross-check, then explain disagreement instead of averaging incompatible values.

skills.title: Equity cash-flow valuation
skills.formula: FCFE = FCFF - interest × (1-tax) + net borrowing; discount at cost of equity.
skills.required_inputs: Dated statements, forecast drivers, valuation purpose, currency, cost of capital, claims and peer definitions.
skills.assumptions: Analyst supplies equity cash flows and next-period terminal FCFE.
skills.validation: Do not subtract debt again from equity value; reconcile financing policy.
skills.failure_modes: Do not apply the operating-company FCFF model to deposit-funded banks, insurers, negative terminal earnings or distressed optional equity without a separate model.

skills.title: Residual income
skills.formula: RI_t = NI_t - k_e × BV_(t-1); equity = BV_0 + PV(RI).
skills.required_inputs: Dated statements, forecast drivers, valuation purpose, currency, cost of capital, claims and peer definitions.
skills.assumptions: Clean-surplus accounting, adjusted book equity and defensible continuing RI.
skills.validation: Zero RI must return opening book equity; no automatic conversion from noisy accounting earnings.
skills.failure_modes: Do not apply the operating-company FCFF model to deposit-funded banks, insurers, negative terminal earnings or distressed optional equity without a separate model.

skills.title: Dividend valuation
skills.formula: Equity = PV(distributions) + PV(first terminal dividend / (k_e-g)).
skills.required_inputs: Dated statements, forecast drivers, valuation purpose, currency, cost of capital, claims and peer definitions.
skills.assumptions: Distributions reflect sustainable payout capacity.
skills.validation: Verify first terminal dividend is not grown twice.

skills.formula: Eligible peer EV / forward EBITDA; median and quartiles; subject forward EBITDA × multiple.

skills.assumptions: Align currency, leases, accounting perimeter and forecast periods.
skills.validation: Exclude non-positive EV or EBITDA; never silently remove an outlier merely to improve the answer.

skills.title: Return on invested capital
skills.formula: ROIC = NOPAT / opening operating invested capital; economic profit = NOPAT - WACC × opening operating invested capital.
skills.required_inputs: Dated statements, forecast drivers, valuation purpose, currency, cost of capital, claims and peer definitions.
skills.assumptions: Capital excludes excess cash; non-positive capital produces an unavailable ratio.
skills.validation: At ROIC equal to WACC, economic profit equals zero; use the same opening capital convention.
skills.failure_modes: Do not apply the operating-company FCFF model to deposit-funded banks, insurers, negative terminal earnings or distressed optional equity without a separate model.

skills.title: Financing capacity
skills.formula: Roll cash forward using operating cash flow less capital expenditure; identify negative projected cash.
skills.required_inputs: Dated statements, forecast drivers, valuation purpose, currency, cost of capital, claims and peer definitions.
skills.assumptions: Fixed debt, no distributions or new financing; a gap is not automatically resolved with a debt plug.
skills.validation: Every forecast balances; report funding needs separately from a model equity value.

skills.title: Bottom-up WACC
skills.formula: beta_L = beta_U × [1+(1-T)D/E]; k_e = r_f + beta_L ERP + exposure × CRP; WACC = E/V k_e + D/V k_d(1-T).
skills.required_inputs: Currency-matched risk-free curve, market equity premium, operating beta, market-value leverage, debt spread, tax capacity and country exposure.
skills.assumptions: Zero debt beta, usable tax shield and explicit country-risk treatment.
skills.validation: All-equity funding must return cost of equity; reject 100% debt weight.
skills.failure_modes: Never use US industry WACC as a ZAR discount rate or mix book debt weights with market equity weights without explanation.
steps: Date every market input and separate currency risk from country exposure.
Unlever comparable betas consistently; select an operating beta and relever to target capital structure.
Calculate cost of equity and after-tax debt cost using market-value weights.
Compare with industry benchmarks as a reasonableness check, not an automatic calibration.

skills.title: Nominal and real consistency
skills.formula: 1 + nominal rate = (1 + real rate) × (1 + expected inflation).
skills.required_inputs: Currency-matched risk-free curve, market equity premium, operating beta, market-value leverage, debt spread, tax capacity and country exposure.
skills.assumptions: Match currency, term and inflation basis across rates and cash flows.
skills.validation: Do not discount real cash flows using nominal WACC; this is a review rule, not automatic FX valuation.
skills.failure_modes: Never use US industry WACC as a ZAR discount rate or mix book debt weights with market equity weights without explanation.
steps: Date every market input and separate currency risk from country exposure.
Unlever comparable betas consistently; select an operating beta and relever to target capital structure.
Calculate cost of equity and after-tax debt cost using market-value weights.
Compare with industry benchmarks as a reasonableness check, not an automatic calibration.

skills.title: Adjusted present value
skills.formula: APV = PV(unlevered cash flows) + PV(explicit tax shields) - PV(distress costs).
skills.required_inputs: Deal perimeter, standalone cash flows, funding schedule, debt-like claims, control assumptions and separately evidenced synergies.
skills.assumptions: Unlevered discount rate; explicit shield timing and separate shield risk.
skills.validation: With zero shields and distress cost, APV equals unlevered DCF. Terminal tax shields are not inferred.
skills.failure_modes: No automatic control premium, synergy uplift or LBO bid ceiling. Those require separately modeled debt schedules, integration costs and return requirements.
steps: Separate standalone enterprise value from transaction price and buyer-specific synergies.
Build a dated financing schedule and verify tax shield usability.
Use APV when financing effects need explicit separation; disclose the tax shield discount convention.
Bridge enterprise to equity and explain model ranges; do not blend control and minority bases.

skills.title: Enterprise-to-equity bridge
skills.formula: Equity = EV + excess cash + non-operating assets - debt - other claims.
skills.required_inputs: Deal perimeter, standalone cash flows, funding schedule, debt-like claims, control assumptions and separately evidenced synergies.
skills.assumptions: Same perimeter and date; no duplicate cash or claim adjustments.
skills.validation: One extra unit of debt reduces equity by one; verify all debt-like claims.
skills.failure_modes: No automatic control premium, synergy uplift or LBO bid ceiling. Those require separately modeled debt schedules, integration costs and return requirements.

skills.title: Transaction synergies
skills.formula: Incremental value = PV(after-tax incremental cash flow - integration costs - incremental reinvestment).
skills.required_inputs: Deal perimeter, standalone cash flows, funding schedule, debt-like claims, control assumptions and separately evidenced synergies.
skills.assumptions: Evidence for timing, overlap, probability and execution costs.
skills.validation: Keep synergy value outside standalone DCF until explicit incremental cash flows are supplied.
skills.failure_modes: No automatic control premium, synergy uplift or LBO bid ceiling. Those require separately modeled debt schedules, integration costs and return requirements.

skills.title: Macro transmission
skills.formula: Growth shift = GDP shock × revenue beta + inflation shock × price pass-through; margin shift = -import share × FX depreciation.
skills.required_inputs: Country, observation dates, publication vintages, inflation, real growth, policy rates, FX exposure and company elasticities.
skills.assumptions: Percentage-point growth and policy shocks; FX percent change; permanent forecast shift.
skills.validation: Zero shocks reproduce baseline; invalid aggregate drivers fail validation.
skills.failure_modes: A macro series is context, not a company growth forecast. Linear elasticities are analyst assumptions, not estimated causal effects.
steps: Construct a country and sector baseline from official observations; distinguish historical releases from forecasts.
Write a causal hypothesis linking each shock to volume, prices, import costs, financing and reinvestment.
Calibrate exposure and pass-through from company evidence; specify lag and persistence outside the simplified scenario if needed.
Run shocks separately and jointly, inspect double counting and disclose coefficient uncertainty.

skills.title: Vintage-aware macro evidence
skills.formula: Record observation period, retrieval date and publication date; prohibit releases after valuation date in historical analysis.
skills.required_inputs: Country, observation dates, publication vintages, inflation, real growth, policy rates, FX exposure and company elasticities.
skills.assumptions: Current World Bank snapshots are not historical release vintages.
skills.validation: Label unavailable vintage data; never claim an absence of look-ahead bias from observation year alone.
skills.failure_modes: A macro series is context, not a company growth forecast. Linear elasticities are analyst assumptions, not estimated causal effects.

skills.title: Correlated valuation simulation
skills.formula: Draw correlated growth, margin and WACC parameters; run the same deterministic FCFF engine for every accepted draw.
skills.required_inputs: Distribution calibration, dependence, exposure horizon, survival probabilities, payment timing and spot curve.
skills.assumptions: PSD correlation; bounded inputs; constant parameter draw across years; base case only.
skills.validation: Seed reproducibility, zero-volatility collapse and rejection disclosure; do not clip invalid tails.
skills.failure_modes: Illustrative normal shocks are not market-implied probabilities. Survival PV is not an insurance reserve or solvency capital model.
steps: State purpose and material risks before selecting deterministic or stochastic form.
Separate process risk, parameter uncertainty and structural uncertainty; the shipped simulation covers parameter uncertainty only.
Validate correlation, use a recorded random seed, and report rejected draws and conditional sample size.
Challenge tails, funding gaps and sensitivity to model form; preserve independent validation evidence.

skills.title: Downside and tail risk
skills.formula: Loss = reference price - model value; empirical 95% VaR and mean of worst ceil(5% × n) losses.
skills.required_inputs: Distribution calibration, dependence, exposure horizon, survival probabilities, payment timing and spot curve.
skills.assumptions: Risk conditional on accepted model draws; loss can be negative when all draws imply gains.
skills.validation: Expected shortfall must be at least VaR within empirical quantile conventions; report reference-price units.
skills.failure_modes: Illustrative normal shocks are not market-implied probabilities. Survival PV is not an insurance reserve or solvency capital model.
steps: State purpose and material risks before selecting deterministic or stochastic form.
Separate process risk, parameter uncertainty and structural uncertainty; the shipped simulation covers parameter uncertainty only.
Validate correlation, use a recorded random seed, and report rejected draws and conditional sample size.
Challenge tails, funding gaps and sensitivity to model form; preserve independent validation evidence.

skills.title: Survival-contingent liability
skills.formula: PV = sum(payment_t × unconditional survival_t / (1+spot_t)^t).
skills.required_inputs: Distribution calibration, dependence, exposure horizon, survival probabilities, payment timing and spot curve.
skills.assumptions: Annual end-year payments; monotonically declining survival; no death benefit or lapse.
skills.validation: Certain single payment matches discounting; zero payments yield zero PV and undefined duration.
skills.failure_modes: Illustrative normal shocks are not market-implied probabilities. Survival PV is not an insurance reserve or solvency capital model.
steps: State purpose and material risks before selecting deterministic or stochastic form.
Separate process risk, parameter uncertainty and structural uncertainty; the shipped simulation covers parameter uncertainty only.
Validate correlation, use a recorded random seed, and report rejected draws and conditional sample size.
Challenge tails, funding gaps and sensitivity to model form; preserve independent validation evidence.

skills.title: Parallel curve sensitivity
skills.formula: Duration = sum(t × PV_t / (1+r_t)) / PV; convexity = sum(t(t+1)PV_t/(1+r_t)^2) / PV.
skills.required_inputs: Distribution calibration, dependence, exposure horizon, survival probabilities, payment timing and spot curve.
skills.assumptions: Small parallel shifts in annual effective spot rates; survival held fixed.
skills.validation: Compare analytic measures to symmetric numerical bumps; do not label this key-rate duration.
skills.failure_modes: Illustrative normal shocks are not market-implied probabilities. Survival PV is not an insurance reserve or solvency capital model.

Separate process risk, parameter uncertainty and structural uncertainty; the shipped simulation covers parameter uncertainty only.

Challenge tails, funding gaps and sensitivity to model form; preserve independent validation evidence.

skills.title: Point-in-time filing selection
skills.formula: Filter observations by filed <= as_of; match unit, start/end and taxonomy; select latest eligible filing per identical period.
skills.required_inputs: Raw provider response, source URL, retrieval time, units, filing accession, period, taxonomy and mapping decisions.
skills.assumptions: Exact caller-approved concept; no universal accounting mapping.
skills.validation: Future filings excluded; distinct period lengths retained; conflicting same-date facts flagged.
skills.failure_modes: Never sum repeated XBRL contexts, substitute annual for quarterly data, or auto-map financial company statements into operating-company FCFF.

Select one unit, accounting concept and period; preserve revisions and filing dates.
Detect missingness, duplicates, stale dates, anomalous scale and taxonomy mismatch.
Require analyst-approved mappings into the opening balance sheet; prove reconciliation and prohibit future filings.

skills.title: Sensitivity surface
skills.formula: Evaluate each WACC/growth pair independently; unsupported pairs are explicitly unavailable.
skills.required_inputs: Typed model outputs, units, scenario labels, selected driver, chart ranges and accessible table equivalents.

skills.title: Value versus suitability
skills.formula: A valuation estimate is an input to a client decision; objectives, risk capacity and liquidity remain independent constraints.
skills.required_inputs: Client goals, liquidity needs, investment horizon, concentration, loss capacity, jurisdiction and constraints.
skills.assumptions: No client suitability inferred from upside percentage.
skills.validation: CFP workflow cannot modify operating-company intrinsic value to fit a desired recommendation.
skills.failure_modes: Intrinsic value alone never establishes suitability. This layer supplies a workflow, not South African tax calculations or regulated advice.
steps: Finish the investment valuation before evaluating suitability.
Assess whether liquidity, concentration and downside fit client objectives and ability to absorb losses.
Identify jurisdiction-specific tax, regulatory and estate-planning questions requiring verified local rules.
Document alternatives, implementation constraints and monitoring needs in a separate client recommendation.
